sourceTitle: Fostering Payment for Skills Scheme 2026-2027 (Staffordshire County Council)

fees.label: Intensive fostering availability fee
fees.note: Paid on top of the allowance

feesNote: Level 1 carers receive the allowance only, Levels 2 to 4 add a skills fee on top that varies with the child's age, and Level 4 fees range from £305.62 to £412.23 a week.
extras: Birthday grant worth one week's allowance for the child's age, paid automatically
Christmas or festival grant worth one week's allowance for the child's age
Summer holiday grant worth two weeks' allowance per child, paid in July
Mileage at 45p a mile with prior agreement
summary: Staffordshire's 2026-27 Payment for Skills scheme pays a weekly allowance for each child in five age bands, with a skills fee on top at Levels 2 to 4 that rises with the child's age and the carer's level. Carers with relevant childcare experience can be considered to start at Level 3, and intensive foster carers receive a weekly availability fee.
